subject: Field demo crate — staging window conflict (SFO)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Ramos <dramos@bluefreight.com>, Harbor Staging Ops <harborops@harborstaging.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T07:42:00-08:00
Subject: Field demo crate — staging window conflict (SFO)

Team — putting this on your radar. We have a Redwood demo crate out of Oakland (BOL_4321) inbound to Harbor Staging for onsite prep ahead of the CloudFin demo on Nov 6. Original delivery window was booked for Nov 4, 09:00-11:00 to allow same-day staging. I just received a note from Blue Freight that Harbor has a site cutover scheduled that morning and they’re reallocating lanes.

Can Harbor Staging confirm if the Nov 4 morning slot is still available? If not, please propose the earliest confirmed slot and whether you can hold the crate on arrival (we need it staged, labeled and scanned into lane 3). This shipment contains demo hardware and loaner units — we cannot miss the Nov 6 show.

Attachments: BOL_4321.pdf, proforma_invoice.pdf

Thanks — Sean
Sean Gallagher
Field Marketing Ops | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
From: Daniel Ramos <dramos@bluefreight.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Harbor Staging Ops <harborops@harborstaging.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Field demo crate — staging window conflict (SFO)

Hi Sean / team — sorry for the short notice. Harbor Staging notified us this morning that they have a planned systems cutover on Nov 4 between 08:00–12:00 which forced a handful of morning deliveries to be bumped. Your booking was flagged as a candidate for reassignment.

Two items to flag: 1) their inbound manifest is missing a commercial invoice on record for BOL_4321 — until that is uploaded in the portal customs will not clear the crate; 2) we can reassign your delivery to Nov 4, 14:00–16:00 or Nov 5, 07:00–09:00.

I uploaded a photo of the crate label to the tracking entry and attached the quick photo here in case the warehouse needs verification (crate_photo.jpg). Tracking: https://tracking.bluefreight.com/track/BF-99871234

Let me know which slot you prefer and confirm that you'll upload the commercial invoice to Harbor's portal ASAP. If you want me to push Harbor to accept a morning slot as an exception, say the word and I'll escalate.

— Daniel Ramos
Blue Freight — SFO Ops
dremos@bluefreight.com
Attachment: crate_photo.jpg
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Ramos <dramos@bluefreight.com>, Harbor Staging Ops <harborops@harborstaging.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Field demo crate — staging window conflict (SFO)

Thanks Daniel — Nov 6 is a hard deadline for the CloudFin demo. We need the crate cleared and staged no later than Nov 5 EOD. Please prioritize Nov 4, 14:00–16:00 if Harbor can accept it; otherwise Nov 5 morning is acceptable but we will need same-day staging support.

I am uploading the commercial invoice and PO right now (purchase_order_987.pdf). Harbor ops — can you confirm that if the invoice is uploaded by 12:00 today you'll accept the 14:00–16:00 window on Nov 4? If not, we need an explicit confirmation for Nov 5 07:00–09:00 so we can adjust trucking.

If we don't have a confirmed slot by 14:00 today I'll need Blue Freight to escalate to Harbor leadership — this is a paid sponsorship activation and missing it will require an incident report.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Events Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: purchase_order_987.pdf

On 2026-11-01T09:10:00-08:00 Daniel Ramos <dramos@bluefreight.com> wrote:
> Hi Sean / team — sorry for the short notice. Harbor Staging notified us this morning that they have a planned systems cutover on Nov 4 between 08:00–12:00 which forced a handful of morning deliveries to be bumped. Your booking was flagged as a candidate for reassignment.
> 
> Two items to flag: 1) their inbound manifest is missing a commercial invoice on record for BOL_4321 — until that is uploaded in the portal customs will not clear the crate; 2) we can reassign your delivery to Nov 4, 14:00–16:00 or Nov 5, 07:00–09:00.
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Harbor Staging Ops <harborops@harborstaging.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Accept & hold BOL_4321 on exception / lane assignment

Harbor Staging team — Grace here from Redwood logistics. Per Marissa and Sean — this shipment contains demo hardware for a confirmed show on Nov 6. We will upload the missing commercial invoice within the hour. Please accept the crate on exception and hold it for Redwood; assign to staging lane 3 and scan into inbound as 'Hold for Redwood — DO NOT RELEASE'. Our trucking partner will deliver to the terminal and linehaul should be on file under BF-99871234.

Staging instructions attached: staging_instructions.pdf. We also request photo documentation at gate and once placed in lane. If Harbor cannot accept the crate on exception we will need explicit confirmation of the Nov 5, 07:00–09:00 slot.

Grace O'Connor
Logistics Coordinator | Redwood Inference
Attachment: staging_instructions.pdf
From: Harbor Staging Ops <harborops@harborstaging.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Field demo crate — staging window conflict (SFO)

Hi Grace / Marissa / Sean — thanks for the follow-up. We located the commercial invoice in the portal this morning (upload timestamp 2026-11-01T11:14). We have scheduled the delivery for Nov 4, 14:00–16:00 and will accept the crate on exception. The crate will be staged to lane 3 and scanned into the inbound manifest as requested; photos will be captured at gate and upon placement.

Please note: because of the cutover we had to compress some morning appointments; our team confirmed the 14:00–16:00 slot this morning only after verifying the invoice. If anything changes we will notify Blue Freight and Redwood immediately.

Drive folder with inbound docs and signed acceptance: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3StagingDocs

Regards,
Harbor Staging Ops
harborops@harborstaging.com
Attachment: acceptance_confirmation.pdf
